correctness.rationale: Legendre proves invariance under p-power multiplication. Kummer forces a-r lower carries and yields E_v>=v. The exact disjoint-r reductions give D_a=min_{v<=a} E_v, and E_1<=c excludes strict improvements at v>=c. The E_1=1 criterion is an exact digit-sum statement. Tested independently through full gcd, factorial, and carry implementations (274, 4400 and 20825 cases). Finite tests support but do not establish the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first unrestricted-m finite stabilization bound is a natural extension of the recent study of g(m,n): it converts the p-component of a gcd of exponentially many large binomials into a bounded finite computation depending only on base-p digits of m. It separates genuine late drops from simple m=p^t examples and classifies valuation one. The question is mathematically motivated by exact restricted binomial gcds, without claiming full factorization or optimal cutoff.
